heading: TOUPA Tung A Habakkuk Phunna
english: The oracle which Habakkuk the prophet saw.

paite: Aw TOUPA, kei bang tan kikou a, nang hon za lou ding na hia? Hiamgamna thu ah na kiang ah ka kikoukhia a, nang lah na hon dawng nuam kei hi.
english: Yahweh, “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. how long will I cry, and you will not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?

paite: Bangziak a thulimlouhna hon musak a, ginatlouhna hon ensak na hia? Lohna leh hiamgamna lah ka ma ah a-om ngal ua; kilanna a-om a, kinakna a-om hi.
english: Why do you show me iniquity, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. There is strife, and contention rises up.

paite: Huaiziak in dan a ze-ol a, vaihawmna akuankhe ngei kei; giloute'n lah diktatte a-umsuak vek ua; huaiziak in vaihawmna pawtkhia hekkawi in a-om hi.
english: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never goes forth; for the wicked surround the righteous; therefore justice goes forth perverted.

paite: Namte lak en unla, thei un, lamdangtak in lamdang sa unla; noute hun sung in nna khat ka sem ding, huai hon hilh mah le uh na gingta nuam kei ding uhi.
heading: TOUPA Dawnna
english: “Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days, which you will not believe though it is told you.

paite: Ngai un, Kaldaite ka bawlkhia hi, huai nam hiamgam leh ngongtat; huaite'n amau tenna mun hilou tang ding in lei vailam khaktan in apai uh.
english: For, behold, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, that march through the breadth of the earth, to possess dwelling places that are not theirs.

paite: Amulkimhuai un alauhuai ua; avaihawmna uh leh athuneihna uh amau ngei a kipan apawtkhia hi.
english: They are feared and dreaded. Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.

paite: Asakolte uh leng gialbemte sang in akinzaw ua, nitaklam ngiate sang in alauhuaizaw uh; asakol tungtuang mite uh akiphalh ua; ahi, gamlapi a kipan asakol tungtuang mite uh ahong pai ua; negai ding a kinoh muvanlai bang in aleng uhi.
english: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.

paite: Hiamgam ding in avek un ahong ua; suahlam huih bang in kilawptak in amailam uh en in atai ua; piaunel bang in salte akaikhawm uhi.
english: All of them come for violence. Their hordes face the desert. He gathers prisoners like sand.

paite: Ahi, amaute'n kumpipate anuihsan ua, amau a ding in thuneite nuihzatna ahi uhi; kulh muanhuai chiteng anuihsan ua; leivui a vum a, alak zel ziak un.
english: Yes, he scoffs at kings, and princes are a derision to him. He laughs at every stronghold, for he builds up an earthen ramp, and takes it.

paite: Huai chiang in huih bang in apaisuak ding ua, mailam anawt zel ding ua, athahatna uh Pathian a neite gilou mohtansak ahi uhi.
english: Then he sweeps by like the wind, and goes on. He is indeed guilty, whose strength is his god.”

paite: Aw TOUPA ka Pathian, ka Mi Siangthou, tangtawn a kipan na hi kei a hia? Ka si kei ding uh, Aw TOUPA, vaihawm ding in amah na hihkipta hi. Nang, Aw suangpi, bawldik ding in amau na tungkheta hi.
heading: Habakkuk Phunna Nihna
english: Aren’t you from everlasting, Yahweh my God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” , my Holy One? We will not die. Yahweh, you have appointed him for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.

paite: Gilou muhna ding a nang mit chiimzaw, hoihlouhna ensim thei lou, bang ding a lepchiahtak a thilbawlte mu a, gilou in ama sang a diktatzaw mi anawmvalh lai a dai maimah na hia?
english: You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously, and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man who is more righteous than he,

paite: Mite tuipi ngasate bang, atung ua vaihawmtu nei lou leh bokvak ganhingte bang a bawl maimah na hi.
english: and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?

paite: Ngakuai in avek un akhaikhe tou a, alen in amau aman a, amaute alenpi a huaikhawm a om in nuamsa in akipak uhi.
english: He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net, and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.

paite: Huaiziak in len a ding in kithoihna alan ua, alenpi ua ding in gimlim ahal hi; amaute ziak a atan uh hoih a, asa uh atam ziak in.
english: Therefore he sacrifices to his net, and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious, and his food is good.

paite: Huaiziak in amau lente hihvuak a, namte hihse gige tel ding ahi uh maw?
english: Will he therefore continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy?
